title: Never Clear a Train That Isn't on the Timetable #shorts
desc:
SIGNALMAN, an unreleased PS2 railway game. At 3:03 a train that isn't on the timetable waits at your signal. The bell code isn't on the list.

Full story on the channel: The PS2 Train Game That Stops Outside Your House (SIGNALMAN, Dead Pixel Studios).

Fiction. PS2-era low-poly visuals, synthetic narration.
